avis.texte: Clears up blemishes and doesn't irritate my skin. Works great

I was recommend this product by a friend. I was very hesitant to use it because I have very sensitive skin. The last 3yrs I have struggled badly with acne. I have more acne now at 33 than I did as a teenager. I started using this 1 week ago and can already tell a difference in my skin! I use the Acne clearing skin wash, retinol acne clearing oil and Calm water gel to finish every night now. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Yes, it does do it all
avis.texte: As a fair-skinned, mid-30s girl I have found myself battling two fronts face-first: acne and aging. When I saw this product, I was apprehensive that this product could actually address both of my concerns. Not only does it address, I am able to notice changes in the feel and appearance of my skin. I notice decrease in blemishes, the hyperpigmentation fades more quickly, and firming/plumping in all the right places.

I love every product from Dermalogica that I have tried, but this clearing oil is one of my favorites. I use it morning and night. I especially see the difference and it's power when I get acne right before my period. It is pricey, but totally worth it.

avis.titre: Finally Found a Holy Grail Product!
avis.texte: I have trial and errored so many skin care products. Some help a little, but I am usually not impressed enough to repurchase. This is one of the first products that agrees with my skin and I truly notice a difference. For reference, I am early 30s, combination skin, prone to hormonal cystic acne. While I know everyone's skin is different, if you've been struggling with hormonal cystic acne, dreaded cysts at that time of the month, give this a try. It seems counterintuitive that putting oil on may help, but this one of the only products that seems to stop a cyst in its tracks for me. If you have had cystic acne and you know that dreaded feeling of a new one popping up, for me, this products reduces the swelling and sometimes prevents it from fully forming. As I've been using this for about a year, I hardly have any breakouts- just a few blemishes around my cycle that this helps clear up quickly. I apply all over at night. If I have a problem area, I may apply an additional drop there and massage it in well. Each bottle last me about 6 months. The smell of the product isn't super appealing, but it is fragrance free- it's just the smell of the ingredients with nothing masking it. I hope they continue to make this product and will continue to recommend to friends. I do wish the bottle was more durable/travel friendly (it feels like glass), but still giving it 5 stars!
Please never discontinue this product; life saving when it comes to my acne. My skin is clear and has stayed breakout free for weeks now. Faded existing acne and keeps new breakouts away!

Love, love, love this soooo much! As a perimenopausal woman, i started having horrible cystic acne on my chin and jawline that would just not go away. This product was highly recommended and have been using this for almost six months and it has not disappointed. And yes, the smell is not the best, but what it does far outweighs that issue. Have been using this on my bf's skin and its been a game changer for him! Worth every single penny
My skin feels brand new after a few weeks of hainf this. Cleared my breakouts in just a few days and my pours have also shrank!

I use this every night after washing my face. My extremely prone to breakouts. Im 41 with adult acne. I saw a difference in my skins texture the first morning I woke up. After a week my skin was glowing and my breakouts have become minimal. Dont get nervous cause its an oil, it will not make you break out more or make your skin oily. Its awesome, I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Great acne care without drying and irritation
avis.texte: My daughter has used prescription retinol for acne for several years. I bought her this as a trial - and within two weeks there was visible clearing of her skin, decongestion, without redness or peeling/flaking. Fantastic!
Wow works amazing if you have mature skin that still has breakouts.
Second time purchasing this product. Sensitive to other retinol products but this one doesn't make me break out.

I usually use the ace Clearing serum from here and i accidently grabbed this one and it made me breakout bad red rashes and pimples :( my fault too because my skin is naturally oily and this one is oil based the other serum is water based :/ but my skin is slowly going back to normal with there acne face wash and the there acne clearing serum which is water based
I have hormonal cystic acne, and this serum helps me keep those breakouts in check.

I only had maybe a week with it before accidentally bumping it over while putting it on and spilled it all in the sink (I'm legally blind without correction and didn't see it there at the moment), but I had started noticing a difference in my acne and really was loving the results!!!!
This product works amazingly well for me. I saw my skin improve within a wee.

avis.titre: The most must have for face
avis.texte: I bought it a year ago and still I have some. Super economy pack. And it is so helpful. But don't use it under the active sun. The best time for using is late falls till early spring. It is the one of the most must have products ever. The most effective formula fights with the dark spots and pigmentation. Anyway it is good to take an advice of your cosmetologist before buying. I used it for the decollete zone as well to fight with pigmentation. And btw you can ask a specialist here online if you have any question about the product or the ussage. It is what I did before using on different body zones

Great addition to my nightly routine. Skin feels brighter and cleaner every day

avis.titre: This product completely changed my skin for the better!!
avis.texte: As a Certified Skin Specialist & a person who has always struggled with sensitive + acne prone skin, I cannot say enough good things about this retinol! It is hard for me to find a product that doesn't dry out & sensitize my skin, but also treats my breakouts. That was until I found this product! Within 3 months my ance has been maintained by at least 75% & I'm starting to see HUGE differences in my hyperpigmentation which is super important as a POC. Definitely a must-try for anyone with breakout-prone skin!!!

I absolutely hate the smell. I find it takes a while to try since it is so oily. My face doesn't hate it but I dread using it due to the smell. I won't buy it. I was given as a gift since I only use their products.

I love another retinol product I've used, so when I ran out I was excited to try a retinol + clearing product from Dermalogica with so many good reviews. However, this oil exacerbated existing acne and, if anything, aged my skin overnight. So disappointing for such a spendy product.
Finally a retinol that doesn't irritate my skin! I've only used it a handful amount of times at this point to see results but it doesn't burn or irritate my skin! It

This serum has helped my acne skins tine and texture. This is definitely a must

I have been using dermalogica skin care for about 7 years now and this product is one of my new favs. Whenever I feel undersurface congestion or have a breakout I apply this clearing oil at night and by morning the breakout is visibly reduced. Within 2-3 days it's gone!
Love this product. Keeps my complexion clear free of imperfections. One of my favorite night time treatment

This was just ok. I got it as a travel size in a kit with other products. Didn't really see any difference in skin with consistent use. Feels nice on the skin and did seem to have some hydrating qualities to it.
I was out of this for 2 weeks, started using it again and my face cleared up drastically! Sometimes I have cystic acne and since I started using this I haven't had any issues.

I have been using this product for over a year and what a difference it has made! I initially purchased this product from my esthetician who highly recommends. So glad I can purchase from Ulta when I run out.

My skin is extremely dry and sensitive and maybe I did not ease into this the right way but it caused my skin it become very dry and irritated. The product itself feels nice on the skin but it unfortunately did not agree with me.

After applying this product three times a week my skin became visibly brighter and my pimples came to the surface a lot faster. This made dealing with breakouts much more manageable due to this products ability to speed up processes of the skin. I would recommend this product to anyone dealing with stubborn breakouts that seem to be takeing foreve to clear up.
This might be my favorite skin care product EVER. I've seen results (both acne- and fine line-related) overnight.

I have combo oily skin thats prone to breakouts and have been using this pretty consistently for over a year. I use about 5 drops max at nightime and its more than enough. The bottle lasts forever. It helps control breakouts (between this and the clearing oil during the day I rarely get any) and smooths me skin. It feels like a babys bottom! So soft, cleared the texture completely! It's moisturizing enough for me that I dont follow up with a cream afterwards (unless its a cold winter). Highly recommend this with the salicylic clearing oil during the day and the microfoliant!
I'm not a fan of the smell, but it works great on my adult acne. I'm hoping it will help with some of the scarring as well after longer use.

First night I used it I woke up and my skin looked and felt amazing. I tried again the second night and woke up with 4 zits on face! I'm 49 and have combination to dry skin. This might work for some, but not for my sensitive skin.
I am 42 and have started to get acne due to hormonal changes and tell you this product helps! Its gentle and heals without drying or itching
Literally cleared some of my skin problems overnight. I've never used something this effective.
The retinol acne clearing oil quickly becomes dry after I applied it. It was quite refreshing.
I have noticed a huge difference in my skin right away. My skin feels softer and old marks have faded quickly. I've only been using it for a week and I am already very happy with the results.

My skin problem is acne. I have been fighting with it for few years already. And it was my dermatologist from Ukraine who recommended me retinol oil from Dermalogica. Together with right creams and cleanser retinol oil makes miracles. I like my skin after it. But be ready to use it during some long time to get the best results if you have dark spots or acne.

I get some horrible breakouts from time to time and they often leave scarring! This oil not only calmed my breakouts, it dried them up and began to exfoliate my skin! In a matter of days, my breakouts disappeared when before this oil it would take weeks! I am very happy with this product!

I am not much of a review writer, but this thing is amazing. I only started having acne in my twenties. By 2014 it was pretty bad and I was prescribed antibiotics. It got much better and I would only get an occasional pimple. Recently, though, maybe two months ago, my skin started freaaaaking out. I have very sensitive and dry skin. It was a disaster. None of my usual remedies helped. Niacimide, zinc, pimple patches. Nada. Plus, all the previous zits were red and inflamed days and days after, as if nothing was healing. I bought this in a moment of slight despair. It is amazing. I am four nights in, but my entire face calmed down. As little as two nights later, everything was better, getting under control, clearing out. I was worried I would purge and it would be worse, since I only rarely use retinol, but it was very gentle.

avis.titre: Amazing oil, highly recommend for hormonal acne
avis.texte: I have hormonal acne and this oil is definitely helping to clear it up and it even refines the skin appearance making it look smoother. I failed to purchase it for about a month and my skin began to deteriorate, the recovery was very noticeable only a week after restarting this product. I highly recommend it!!

I just love this. I tried this after a recommendation from my esthetician, and it has definitely helped to keep my skin clear. I have dealt with adult acne for years, and this has helped in so many ways. I have tried lots of retinol, but I love that this retinol also helps battle acne-prone skin. I can't imagine not using this, it is my favorite skincare product at the moment. The smell is a little different, but it doesn't bother me. A little goes a long way!

As an esthetician myself, I stumbled onto this product after receiving a sample from my spa. At the time I was very desperate because I started to have extremely bad cystic acne and nothing seemed to calmed it down. After using the retinol oil for 2 weeks it completely cleared my skin and I always have back ups of this product whenever I feel a break out come up. Happy to say I am acne free for 2 years now.
Loved this product. I has my skin glowing and clear. I have sensitive skin and suffer from hormonal breakouts and this product really does help.

I love the results of this retinol oil! With consistency the results are insane. Texture & overall pigmentation clarity is worth it. The smell is not my favorite but a few drops go a long way. I actually use a pea size of retin-a 4 drops of this oil & my skin has NEVER looked so good! I do the double cleanse with the dermalogica kit, then apply this after.
I have tried this product along with my sister and we both love it for different issues. Ages 26 and 33
This really helped in clearing my acne and helping my overall texture!
This stuff works and applies effortlessly. Only dislike is the smell.

avis.titre: I almost returned this but thenâ€¦..

Helped me within a week! I have noticed the difference in my skin.
I had the biggest sit ever on my nose after using for two days.

When I use this I wake up with deep painful cystic acne. My skin usually reacts really well to retinol. Disappointed because I finally figured out that it was causing acne and not just purging but it's been a couple months that I have had it :/

My favorite product from Dermalogica - and I typically love all their products! My skin has reacted badly to retinol products in the past, but this one from Dermalogica is gentle enough for me to use every night and leaves my skin looking bright and moisturized in the morning! I have adult acne and it has reduced it almost entirely. Love this product!
I am 72 and still have cycstic acne plus scars from old cysts. This oil has calmed my still-active cysts. I am liking it!

The price makes me want to die, but my acne (which was the worst it had ever been in my life) had visible improvement over night and now a month later is almost completely gone. I have extremely sensitive skin so I was nervous about how it would react, but it actually improved the irritation I had from trying other products. It does however smell quite bad if you can go in store and give it a sniff before buying I would. I don't notice it after it's been on for a couple minutes and I "sandwich" it between my moisturizer which has a much more pleasant scent. I never feel motivated to write reviews, but if you have been struggling with adult, hormonal acne, this is what turned the tide for me! My skin hasn't been this clear, soft, and hydrated in over a year.
I love this product! I deal with acne as an adult and I find this product to really help my skin maintain clarity and youthfulness!

I did not care for it at all. I hated the odor. It smelled like garden weeds. I did not like the way it dribbled down my face; the method of application was horrible. I returned the container immediately. I could not see using this product at all! What a horrible skin product. Lousy! I could not find one redeeming thing to say about this product at all, and I am not typically a complainer.
Like the product. Use it s few times a week and does not dry up my skin, which usually happens. Would buy again

I developed adult acne (hormonal acne) and I've used the Retinol oil 1-2 times weekly for several years. I have very sensitive skin and as long as I don't use too much product, my skin likes it. If I use a little too much oil, it can burn my skin as well as cause breakouts. I found a balance that works for my skin, and it's a nice routine a couple nights a week. It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and fairly pimple free.

I have been using this oil for weeks and it has not changed my skin at allâ€¦ my pores are still enlarged, breakouts have not disappeared, and flaws on my face are still presentâ€¦ this is negative for me! I will not buy again..
I have aggressive cystic acne and whenever I go to bed with this serum on, I wake up and my skin feels less inflamed and feels reduced in redness and bumpiness!
This product is a staple in my skin care routine. It's helps minimize my pores keep imperfections from coming through, leaving my skin looking balanced.
Not excessively drying to my skin like I was concerned about, though I use quite a sparing amount.

I struggle with deep cystic acne and am prone to millia. Pro and con is that this product WILL purge deep congestion. It works but is intense! I have been using this 2-3xs a week, taking breaks when too much flaking or irritation occurs, for almost 3 months. Milia is nearly gone by this point. At time it almost falls out without any manual extraction required. Its been a rough go dealing with cycles of purging but is improving and results are noticable. Flaking and irritation come with the territory and I think lighter surface acne has occurred since this is oil based. Its not perfect but does a good job pushing out sebum and knots of protein. The product is silky and feels great. Smell is light and medicinal. May not be for everyone but great if you like an herbal scent. Only 4 stars as it helps with some problems but creates new ones. Worth a shot if you have deep acne. I will continue to use and keep in my arsenal.

avis.titre: best addition to my night routine
avis.texte: My new holy grail product for my night time routine. When using this oil I double cleanse and then skip the toner and moisturizer. The retinol is oil based, so it's important for the product to be able to soak into the skin with nothing beneath or over it. It's a powerful oil, so I only use it every few nights. Everytime I use it, my skin looks visibly nicer the next day.
I wish that this product wasn't so oily and I cannot tolerate the smell. It reminds me of an old musty basement. I miss the Clearing Mattifier!
Skin has improved so much since adding this serum to my nighttime skin routine.

I expected more from this product given the price. It's fine, but not the "holy grail" people are making it out to be. It's a nice, lightly scented oil - it didn't cause any more breakouts (but didn't clear my skin, either) and moisturized well enough without leaving me extra oily, but after nightly use for a month, I haven't noticed any changes in my skin, overall. I probably won't buy it again unless it was on an amazing sale. It's much too expensive to be just fine.
I get sebum and white heads and when I use this at night, I notice they clear right up!
This oil feels so great on my skin, absorbs so easily and I wake up with a glow! Love it and it'll stay part of my nighttime routine.

Loved this retinol - First one I've ever tried but will definitely be sticking to it. Went on vacation so didn't take any with me and noticed the difference right away. What I noticed right away was my black heads disappeared immensely, also softer blackheads so easier to extract without creating damage. Reduction in pores on cheeks. Hydrated skin. As well as when I got back from my vacation I had gotten 2 pimples - 1 was inflamed and once I got back home the first night I applied the retinol, I woke up with the inflamed breakout completely diminished from raised and inflamed. Skins appearance looks crazy great - would recommend the sound sleep cocoon from dermalogica to apply over the retinol.
I added the Retinol Acne Clearing Oil to my night routine when it came out (year+ ago?) and have noticed my skin is more smooth and clear. It's been a great addition!
I love how it makes my skin feel. It's gentle enough that my daughter uses it too!
This goes on smoothly. I love this stuff. I have been using this for at least a year by now.

avis.titre: This is my lifesaver. It keeps the calcium "knots" off of my

avis.titre: Been using for a couple years

Love love love this !! I can't describe how much I love this one !!

This is my non-negotiable skin care item! It's so nourishing, keeps my skin clear and glowy without clogging any pores. Most retinol products are way too drying, so this oil is a hero for my combo skin!

I'm a loyal Dermalogica customer; my face routine relies 90% on Dermalogica products; this is probably one of my favorite products; it's great! I use retinol serum in the morning and retinol acne oil at night, perfect duo! The only downside is that it is becoming expensive, I found a better option in the market to replace them in my daily routine, but these two are very good products from Dermalogica.

This oil is just amazing! As someone who had struggled with acne for years and has used many harsh products it is so refreshing to find a product that is VERY effective, but still feels gentle. My skin is so clear and SO SMOOTH. I use this every night and it is the one step in my skincare routine I will never ever skip!
I used to have a mild breakouts but after using this product for almost 2 months I'm having breakouts every single day. I don't know why and I'm really disappointed. Any recommendations pleaseâ€¦

avis.texte: I am a dermalogica fanatic. I own about 20 different products. I do like this product, but when I contacted the company they refused to give me even a minimal discount to cover damage to a product that they make from glass. To top this off, when I contacted customer serviceâ€¦ they replied and then kicked me out of the conversation before I could even have time to read their response. Very unprofessional and disappointed in their company. If purchasing this product, keep in a secure area or it might fall and breakâ€¦ it would most likely break from only a 2-3 inch fall, then you're faced with $80+ down the drain.

I find this oil excellent for keeping acne at bay. With regular use I have significantly fewer breakouts.
So far this oil has been working wonders. Complexion looks more radiant and clear. I only use at night before bed and I wake up refreshed. Love it.
Definitely used as a spot treatment, if you spread it all over your face its so strong it will actually begin to pull out impurities but it will look like youre breaking out.

I have sensitive skin with an oily T-Zone, prone to breakouts on chin and cheeks. During the first two weeks of use I experienced unusual breakouts because the retinol speeds up cell turn over. If this happens to you, stick with it! My pores have significantly improved, less buildup, smaller appearance. I use this every night and find the oils hydrating enough to not need to moisturise on top of it. In the morning I use a hyaluronic or vitamin c serum then Intensive Moisture Balance or Skin Smoothing moisturiser, followed by sun screen. This oil has been great for my adult acne and plumping my skin. I wish that the percentage of retinol was given and that better instructions for use were given. I think a lot of people are unsure if they can put a moisturiser on top.
